newsitem.title: USA: Leap Group unit launches Web software.
newsitem.headline: Leap Group unit launches Web software.

text.p: Leap Group Inc said Tuesday its Quantum Leap division has launched an Internet publishing application that allows development of customized online information with integrated multimedia components on the World Wide Web.
Called Quantum Objects, the software is designed to take multiple types of information currently published on the Web and turn them into dynamic Web pages, the company said.
Quantum Leap said the first commercial application of the software will be an online arts and entertainment guide that will be published by an unidentified newspaper this month.
Leap Group is a strategic communications company.
Its shares were unchanged Tuesday at 7-3/4.
